context.body: Continuity of God, people, and instruction is joined to a changed mode of covenant knowledge.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD promises a new covenant unlike the broken exodus covenant, writes instruction on hearts, renews belonging, spreads knowledge, and forgives sin.
observations.label: God promises instruction written within: action

observations.body: The houses of Israel and Judah receive a restored relation not sustained by external teaching alone.
observations.label: God promises instruction written within: response

observations.body: new covenant · write it in their heart · know me · forgive
observations.label: Words in Jeremiah 31:31–34

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 31:31–34 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: “They will all know me” is promised within a restored covenant but does not erase every later need for teaching in one stroke.
payload.title: God promises instruction written within
